characters.summary: Plastic Man possesses absolute malleability, allowing him to stretch, reshape, and transform his body into any form imaginable with near-invulnerability to physical trauma. He relies on close-quarters grappling, deception, and stealth by flattening or morphing into inanimate objects.

techniques: Shape-shifting into giant mallets and weapons
Morphing into everyday objects for stealth attacks

mechanisms: Extreme elastic resilience granting near-immunity to blunt force, bullets, and piercing weapons
Regenerative reconstitution from fragments or liquid states

weaknesses: Extreme cold causing brittleness or freezing
Chemical solvents or organic solvents that can dissolve or destabilize his polymer structure
limitations: Vulnerability to extreme temperature shifts like intense cold

sources.supports: General overview of powers, origins, and vulnerabilities.

feats.claim: Survived being frozen for thousands of years and shattered, later reassembling himself after being thawed.

notableResults.note: Batman acknowledges that Plastic Man is virtually indestructible and nearly impossible to permanently defeat.

campaignTags.claim: Can alter his size and mass to grow into giant shapes or shrink to microscopic scales.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of the mass he can generate or stretch to without losing cohesion.

characters.summary: Poison Ivy is a botanical master who utilizes plant-based toxins, pheromones, and direct control over flora to overwhelm opponents. She fights using summoned vines, deadly spores, and mind-altering pheromone manipulation.

techniques: Toxic spore dispersion and poisonous kisses

mechanisms: Natural plant armor and summoned thickets
Immunity to most toxins, venoms, and diseases

weaknesses: Darkness and prolonged absence of sunlight weakening her biological connection to the Green
mobility: Swinging or riding on animated vines
limitations: Depowered or severely weakened in environments entirely devoid of plant life or sunlight

sources.supports: Overview of her plant manipulation powers, toxins, and origins.

feats.claim: Controlled the minds of nearly the entire population of Metropolis using an enhanced synthetic pollen.

notableResults.note: Utilized enhanced pheromones to place Superman under her complete mental control.

campaignTags.claim: Employs chemical pheromones to bend human minds to her will.

unknowns: The precise threshold where her connection to the Green can be permanently severed.

characters.summary: Power Girl is a Kryptonian from an alternate universe who possesses immense superhuman strength, speed, invulnerability, and heat vision. She fights with a direct, aggressive brawling style combined with high-speed aerial assaults.

mechanisms: Near-invulnerability to conventional physical attacks
Superhuman stamina and rapid cellular recovery under yellow sunlight

weaknesses: Vulnerability to Kryptonite from her native universe (Earth-2)
limitations: Power levels depend on absorption of yellow solar radiation
Susceptible to magical attacks and Earth-2 Kryptonite

sources.supports: Overview of powers, Kryptonian physiology, and alternate earth origins.

feats.claim: Lifted and hurled heavy tectonic plates and massive structures during crisis events.

notableResults.note: Overpowered in close combat by Black Adam's magical strength.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly at hypersonic speeds under yellow sunlight.

unknowns: Extent of her resilience against various mystical entities compared to mainstream Superman.

characters.summary: Ra's al Ghul is an ancient eco-terrorist mastermind who combines centuries of martial arts mastery, tactical genius, and vast organizational resources. He fights using advanced swordsmanship, stealth, and lethal chemical concoctions.

mechanisms: Advanced body armor
Peak human physical conditioning and martial arts counter-techniques
Restoration from fatal injuries via Lazarus Pits

weaknesses: Temporary madness and vulnerability following immersion in a Lazarus Pit
Human physical limits without regular restoration
mobility: Global transportation network via League of Assassins
limitations: Possesses normal human physical durability outside of regenerative Lazarus Pit effects
Prone to post-Lazarus pit temporary insanity

sources.supports: Overview of background, Lazarus Pits, combat skills, and leadership of the League of Assassins.

feats.claim: Fought Batman to a standstill in hand-to-hand combat using a traditional scimitar.

notableResults.note: Defeated in single combat when Batman outmaneuvered his blade techniques.

conditional.dependsOn: Regular immersion in a Lazarus Pit

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes master assassin training to infiltrate secure locations undetected.

unknowns: Exact chemical composition and side effects of varied Lazarus Pit formulations across different global sites.

characters.summary: Raven is a half-demon empath and sorceress who channels dark dimensional energies to fight her enemies. She utilizes astral projection, shadow manipulation, and powerful telekinetic or mystic blasts.

techniques: Soul-self projection for ranged attacks and scouting

mechanisms: Mystical force fields
Intangibility via soul-self transformation

weaknesses: Vulnerability to overwhelming emotional corruption or losing control over her demonic heritage
Mental strain when absorbing too much negative emotion
limitations: Must maintain strict emotional control to prevent her demonic father Trigon from taking over

sources.supports: Overview of empathic powers, soul-self abilities, and demonic heritage.

feats.claim: Subdued multiple members of the Justice League simultaneously using her soul-self.

notableResults.note: Defeated her father with the aid of the Titans by channeling pure good souls to cleanse him.

campaignTags.claim: Casts complex dark magic spells and dimensional portals.
Levitates and flies using mystical energy.
Creates dimensional portals for travel and combat manipulation.

unknowns: Full extent of her abilities when completely untethered from human morality.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Dark Nights: Death Metal
characters.summary: The Unkindness form is an apocalyptic, corrupted peak version of Raven who has consumed boundless dark power and magical entities across the multiverse. She obliterates opponents through absolute conceptual erasure and vast dark magic.

mechanisms: Invulnerability granted by multiversal energy absorption
Regeneration from conceptual damage

weaknesses: Risk of complete erasure of self if internal corruption overrides her consciousness
limitations: Dependent on the continued containment of consumed dark energies
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Raven from a standard empathic sorceress into a cosmic entity of pure destruction, multiplying her magical output to multiversal scales.

sources.supports: Context on alternate high-tier forms and dark magical power scaling.

feats.claim: Destroyed and consumed entire pantheons of magical beings across multiple timelines.
feats.citation: Dark Nights: Death Metal - Trinity Crisis #1

notableResults.citation: Dark Nights: Death Metal - Rise of the New God #1
notableResults.note: Overwhelmed and consumed the divine power of the Spectre during the crisis.

conditional.dependsOn: Absorbing the power of multiple magical entities across realities

campaignTags.claim: Wields supreme dark magic capable of rewriting reality.

unknowns: Whether this form can be maintained indefinitely without collapsing the user's psyche.

characters.summary: White Raven is a purified, transcendent form of Raven where her soul-self and spirit are completely free of demonic taint. She wields amplified holy light and absolute spiritual purification magic.

mechanisms: Divine protective auras
Immunity to dark corruption and demonic possession

weaknesses: Vulnerability to sudden corrupting influences if her emotional balance is violently broken
limitations: Form is often temporary, reverting to standard status once internal peace is tested
characters.formDifferences: Replaces Raven's dark shadow-based abilities with pure holy light and amplified spiritual dominion over demonic entities.

sources.supports: Documentation of Raven's white costume transformation and spiritual purification.

feats.claim: Purified entire armies of corrupted souls and demon-possessed hosts with a single wave of light.

notableResults.note: Dispelled Brother Blood's dark cultist energies using purified white light.

conditional.ability: Absolute spiritual immunity and amplified holy magic
conditional.dependsOn: Achieving complete emotional harmony and purging demonic influence

campaignTags.claim: Casts high-level purification and holy magic spells.

unknowns: The exact duration she can sustain the White Raven transformation under combat stress.

characters.summary: Red Hood (Jason Todd) is a lethal vigilante who combines peak human conditioning, master-level firearms proficiency, and advanced tactical combat. He fights aggressively using dual pistols, blades, and explosive gadgets.

mechanisms: Tactical body armor with helmet protection
Advanced evasive martial arts and defensive reflexes

weaknesses: Prone to emotional volatility and recklessness when confronting past trauma
limitations: Dependent on ammunition and physical gear replenishment
Vulnerable to conventional injuries despite heavy body armor

sources.supports: Overview of Red Hood identity, combat skills, weapons, and origin.

feats.claim: Held his own in close-quarters combat against Batman while simultaneously deploying firearms and tactical explosives.

notableResults.note: Subdued by Batman after a prolonged ideological and physical confrontation.

campaignTags.claim: Employs custom firearms, tasers, and explosive charges in combat.
Utilizes assassination and tactical stealth techniques.

unknowns: Exact recovery time and aftereffects following his resurrection in the Lazarus Pit.

characters.summary: Red Robin is a master tactician and deductive genius who relies on superior intellect, staff-based martial arts, and advanced detective gear. He fights by exploiting opponent weaknesses through rapid tactical analysis.

mechanisms: Armored tactical suit
Defensive staff parrying and acrobatic evasion

weaknesses: Human physical fragility compared to meta-human opponents
Reliance on preparation and tactical intelligence
limitations: Vulnerable to direct overwhelming physical force if caught unprepared

sources.supports: Overview of Tim Drake as Red Robin, detective skills, and bo staff proficiency.

feats.claim: Deduced the secret identities of multiple major superheroes independently before joining Batman.

notableResults.note: Defeated multiple trained assassins using environment and bo staff mastery.

campaignTags.claim: Uses customized computers, smoke pellets, and projectile gadgets.
Employs stealth and recon techniques as a master detective.

unknowns: Upper limits of his computational planning speed against unpredictable cosmic entities.

characters.summary: Red Tornado is an advanced android possessing complete control over wind currents and aerodynamic forces. He fights by generating devastating tornadoes, high-speed gale-force winds, and utilizing flight.

mechanisms: Durable android chassis resistant to conventional ballistics
Defensive wind barriers deflecting incoming projectiles

weaknesses: Vulnerability to magnetic manipulation and EMPs
Internal machinery susceptible to sophisticated tech hacking
limitations: Susceptible to technological disablement via EMP or advanced hacking
Requires structural repairs if android body is heavily breached

sources.supports: Overview of android nature, wind manipulation powers, and Justice League affiliation.

feats.claim: Generated continent-scale windstorms to counter atmospheric threats.

notableResults.note: Blasted Solomon Grundy into the upper atmosphere using a sustained cyclone vortex.

campaignTags.claim: Constructed as an artificial intelligence housed within a synthetic android body.
Propels himself through the air using internal wind generation.

unknowns: The absolute processing speed of his sentient AI core when confronting reality-warping entities.
